title: Unguarded hops[int(off)] and pipe_tier[rep_slot] derefs after non-fatal expectf checks
evidence:
off, count, ok := routing_equal_cost_hops(&s.routing, &s.topology, res, host)
	testing.expectf(t, ok, "(res,host) must resolve")
	testing.expectf(t, count == 1,
		"the re-priced fat bundle must win UNIQUELY (count 1), got %d", count)
	testing.expectf(t, s.routing.hops[int(off)].node == m1,
		"next hop must be m1 (bundle priced at its min member: 5+5=10), got %d — the bundle edge was NOT re-priced",
		s.routing.hops[int(off)].node)
detail: expectf records and continues; if ok==false or count==0, off is not guaranteed valid, so hops[int(off)] risks out-of-bounds panic or garbage-hop read masking the real failure. rep_slot stays -1 when its expectf fails, yet pipe_tier[rep_slot] (:283) and pipe_id[rep_slot] (:286) are dereferenced.
recommended_fix: Guard with early returns: bail when !ok, count != 1, !bfound, or rep_slot == -1 before any hops/pipe_tier/pipe_id dereference.
